item.title: GJ Chamber of Commerce keeping members connected to city officials
item.description: The chamber invited city officials to speak with members of the chamber in a "speed round-robin" format. Candace Carnahan, president and CEO of the Grand Junction Chamber of Commerce, says this was the first time they've held a luncheon in this format.

item.title: Multiple fire agencies tackle structure fire near Whitewater
item.description: Multiple fire agencies in Mesa County responded to a structure fire in the 4000 block of Reeder Mesa, which contained a large amount of ammunition.

item.title: San Miguel County Coroner identifies man found dead near Norwood
item.description: The San Miguel County Coroner's Office has identified the man found dead on a county road on Sunday as 55-year-old Timothy Workman.

item.title: Despite national airport chaos, GJT is running smoothly according to CEO
item.description: GRAND JUNCTION Colo. (KREX)- At Grand Junction Regional Airport, it’s business as usual, according to CEO Angela Padalecki, despite challenges seen elsewhere. “We recognize that at some airports, they have problems that are more complex than what we see here. item.title: It's been nearly a full week of record-breaking temperatures
item.description: The clouds of yesterday may have cooled temperatures a little, but it still broke a record. That trend continues today as well, but with less clouds.

item.title: Alex Kelloff talks to WesternSlopeNow about congressional run
item.description: Alex Kelloff, a Democratic candidate with a 30-year business career, is running for Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District seat currently held by incumbent Jeff Hurd. Kelloff cited concerns regarding the country's current direction and a lack of rural representation as his primary motivations for seeking office.

item.description: GRAND JUNCTION Colo. item.title: CAF hosted their TBM Rides Day to the Grand Valley
item.description: The Commemorative Air Force Rocky Mountain Wing hosted its TBM Rides Day on Saturday morning, offering community members the chance to fly in a historical TBM Avenger. The event took place in the Grand Valley and allowed participants to view the area from the air.

item.title: GJPD seeking information on motorcyclist who fled from officers
item.description: The Grand Junction Police Department is seeking community assistance in identifying a motorcyclist who reportedly fled from officers during a traffic stop.
